items.event: Presidents Cup — USA vs. International, Medinah
items.line: Team USA leads the Internationals 3-2 after Thursday's fourballs, with Friday foursomes tight (Conners/Taylor and Im/Matsuyama both up on Scheffler/Burns and Henley/Bridgeman). Saturday four-ball tees off this evening JST; it comes down to Sunday's winner-take-all singles.

items.event: Laver Cup 2026 — Team Europe vs. Team World, The O2
items.line: Team Europe (Alcaraz, Zverev, Ruud, host advantage) took an early lead after Casper Ruud came back to beat Francisco Cerundolo on Day 1. Saturday's day/night sessions run today with more Alcaraz doubles action; the Cup is likely decided in Sunday's live singles.

items.event: England vs. Spain — UEFA Nations League opener, Wembley
items.line: Newly crowned world champions Spain (unbeaten in 5, seven clean sheets in their last 8) make their first appearance since beating Argentina in the 2026 World Cup final, visiting an England side still stinging from a semi-final loss to Argentina. A rerun of the Euro 2024 final to open the new Nations League group.
